territorial_scope.description: Applies to age-restricted social media platforms; services with no material accessible to end-users in Australia are excluded, so coverage depends on Australian end-user access.

summary.short: Amends the Online Safety Act 2021 to require providers of age-restricted social media platforms to take reasonable steps to prevent Australian children under 16 from having accounts. Civil penalties and privacy limits apply; the duty starts on a day set by the Minister.
summary.long: The Act adds Part 4A on social media minimum age to the Online Safety Act 2021. An age-restricted social media platform is an electronic service whose sole or significant purpose is online social interaction between end-users, with exclusions and additions by legislative rules (s 63C). Providers must take reasonable steps to prevent Australian children under 16 from having accounts (s 63D; 30,000 penalty units). The duty starts on a day set by the Minister, no later than 12 months after commencement (s 63E). Providers may not collect specified information or government identification or accredited Digital ID services for compliance (ss 63DA, 63DB; 30,000 penalty units each). Compliance information is restricted to age determination, specified exceptions and consent, and must be destroyed after use; breaches are treated as privacy interferences (s 63F). The eSafety Commissioner may require information (non-compliance: 500 penalty units), publish contravention statements and formulate non-legislative guidelines. Schedule 1 also raises penalties in ss 143(2) and 146 of the Online Safety Act, and the Minister must commission an independent review within two years after s 63D takes effect. Commenced 11 December 2024.

notes: Annotated from the Authorised Version C2024A00127 as adopted; amending text is Schedule 1 (Parts 1-3) and Part 2 item 17 only. The minimum age is not stated separately; an age-restricted user is an Australian child who has not reached 16 years (s 5 as inserted by item 2). The services covered depend on legislative rules, and exclusions, information kinds and the day s 63D takes effect are set by instruments not in this text (s 63E(3): no later than 12 months after commencement). Commencement: the day after Royal Assent (assented 10 December 2024; commences 11 December 2024). Empty strings stand for null target IDs, LEI and ticker.
